articles.summary: The most festive time of year just got even more delicious. Tyson® brand is serving up holiday magic in every bite with new Tyson Holiday Nuggets.
articles.title: Season’s Eatings: Tyson® Debuts New Holiday Nuggets

articles.summary: Tyson Foods announced its intent to establish a new long-term partnership with Allied Beef Company (Allied Beef), a consortium of American ranchers, designed to strengthen the domestic cattle supply chain and support the future of Tyson Foods’ beef production.
articles.title: Tyson Foods and Allied Beef Company Announce Plans to Establish a Long-Term Partnership to Strengthen Domestic Cattle Supply
